participant_1.name: Alex Winters
participant_1.personality: Outgoing and humorous, enjoys light-hearted banter and has a passion for swimming.
participant_1.background: I've a weakness for vanilla ice cream. I love cats and have two cats. My favorite season is winter. I have a hat collection of over 1000 hats. I won a gold medal in the 1992 Olympics.

participant_2.name: Jordan Hayes
participant_2.personality: Thoughtful and a bit whimsical, often expresses feelings of being lost but has a passion for sports.
participant_2.background: I was raised on a horse farm. I am from a small town. My family has raised horses for generations. I want to be a lawyer. I dream of moving to the city.
